title: arctostaphylos pungens subsp. nevadensis
intro: Arctostaphylos pungens subsp. nevadensis, commonly known as Point Reyes manzanita, is a shrub species in the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is native to the Point Reyes Peninsula in California and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Point Reyes manzanita include its potential to help with antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may aid in wound healing and the prevention of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
